description: Found while building fz-sc8.72. `%{m | :a => 3}` does not parse: "expected keyword entry". Elixir accepts any key expression with => in a map update, and keyword syntax (a: 3) is sugar for atom keys. The update parser (src/parser) accepts only the keyword form; map literals already accept both. Fold the two so the update reads the same entry grammar as the literal. Oracle fixture with an atom key via =>, a string key, and a mixed update. Deviation from Elixir; not needed by the distiller.
title: Map update accepts => keys: %{m | :a => 3}
